relevant_contracts: rating history and explicit baseline skip

success_criterion_regression_coverage.evidence: Public navigation, account controls, response controls, and ordering buttons are exercised without pointer-only behavior.
Validation errors move focus to the first invalid response control; posted results receive focus after submission.
Ordering uses named Move up and Move down buttons and exposes no draggable-only control.
E2E checks enforce at least 44 CSS pixels for tested canonical form targets, exceeding the 24 CSS pixel AA minimum.
Prompt-aware summaries and inline messages identify missing or invalid responses and link to the affected prompt.
Response controls retain prompt-derived accessible labels, instructions, and described-by error associations.
Rendered-markup and browser contracts verify named native controls, dialog/menu labeling, progress semantics, and response-control state.
Attempt validation, save, result, media, and progress states use application status-message contracts and focus where interruption is required.

responsive_observations.wide_table_behavior: The source table is contained in its own keyboard-focusable horizontal scroll region at 320 CSS pixels.

limitations: This report is regression evidence, not a claim of complete WCAG 2.2 conformance.
The automated browser matrix is Chromium-only.
No qualified independent accessibility reviewer or assistive-technology matrix has signed off CF-7.
The source DOCX was fully rendered and inspected, but browser comparison is representative rather than a screenshot pair for all 85 sections.
